Terraform module to manage Oxbow Lambda and its components
summary: Oxbow is a project to take an existing storage location which contains Apache Parquet files into a Delta Lake table. It is intended to run both as an AWS Lambda or as a command line application. We are excited to introduce terraform-oxbow, an open-source Terraform module that simplifies the deployment and management of AWS Lambda and its supporting components. Whether you’re working with AWS Glue, Kinesis Data Firehose, SQS, or DynamoDB, this module provides a streamlined approach to infrastructure as code (IaC) in AWS.
body_text: Oxbow is a project to take an existing storage location which contains Apache Parquet files into a Delta Lake table . It is intended to run both as an AWS Lambda or as a command line application. We are excited to introduce terraform-oxbow , an open-source Terraform module that simplifies the deployment and management of AWS Lambda and its supporting components. Whether you’re working with AWS Glue, Kinesis Data Firehose, SQS, or DynamoDB, this module provides a streamlined approach to infrastructure as code (IaC) in AWS. ✨ Why terraform-oxbow? Managing event-driven architectures in AWS can be complex, requiring careful orchestration of multiple services. Terraform-oxbow abstracts much of this complexity, enabling users to configure key components with simple boolean flags and module parameters. This is an easy and efficient way to have Delta table created using Apache Parquet files. 🚀Features With terraform-oxbow , you can deploy: AWS Oxbow Lambda with customizable configurations Kinesis Data Firehose for real-time data streaming SQS and SQS Dead Letter Queues for event-driven messaging IAM policies for secure access management S3 bucket notifications to trigger Lambda functions DynamoDB tables for data storage and locking AWS Glue Catalog and Tables for schema management ⚙️ How It Works This module follows a modular approach, allowing users to enable or disable services based on their specific use case. Here are a few examples: To enable AWS Glue Catalog and Tables: hcl enable_aws_glue_catalog_table = true To enable Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream hcl enable_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream = true To enable S3 bucket notifications hcl enable_bucket_notification = true To enable advanced Oxbow Lambda setup for multi-table filtered optimization hcl enable_group_events = true AWS S3 bucket notifications have limitations: Due to AWS constraints, an S3 bucket can only have a single notification configuration per account. If you need to trigger multiple Lambda functions from the same S3 bucket, consider using event-driven solutions like SNS or SQS. IAM Policy Management: The module provides the necessary permissions but follows the principle of least privilege. Ensure your IAM policies align with your security requirements. Scalability and Optimization: The module allows fine-grained control over Lambda concurrency, event filtering, and data processing configurations to optimize costs and performance Related Jobs View All Jobs

title: Convocation de l’Assemblée Générale du 23 mai 2025
summary: Paris, 24 mars 2025 – Le Conseil d’administration de TotalEnergies SE s’est réuni le 19 mars 2025 sous la présidence de M. Patrick Pouyanné, Président-directeur général. Il a décidé de convoquer l’Assemblée générale ordinaire et extraordinaire des actionnaires de la Société le vendredi 23 mai 2025. L’avis de réunion de cette Assemblée sera publié prochainement […]
body_text: Paris, 24 mars 2025 – Le Conseil d’administration de TotalEnergies SE s’est réuni le 19 mars 2025 sous la présidence de M. Patrick Pouyanné, Président-directeur général. Il a décidé de convoquer l’Assemblée générale ordinaire et extraordinaire des actionnaires de la Société le vendredi 23 mai 2025. L’avis de réunion de cette Assemblée sera publié prochainement au BALO (Bulletin des Annonces Légales et Obligatoires) et pourra être consulté sur le site internet de la Société. Le Conseil d’administration a également approuvé les documents qui seront soumis à l’Assemblée générale, incluant notamment le Rapport de gestion sur la situation de la Compagnie. Gouvernance de la Compagnie Les mandats d’administrateur de Mme Lise Croteau, Mme Maria van der Hoeven, M. Jean Lemierre et Mme Emma de Jonge, administrateur représentant les salariés actionnaires, viennent à échéance à l’issue de l’Assemblée générale des actionnaires du 23 mai 2025. Sur proposition du Comité de gouvernance et d’éthique, le Conseil d’administration a décidé de soumettre à l’Assemblée générale le renouvellement, pour une période de trois années, du mandat d’administrateur de Mme Lise Croteau. Compte tenu de la pratique de gouvernance du Conseil d’administration de la Société selon laquelle un administrateur ne doit pas atteindre l’âge de 75 ans au cours de son mandat, Mme Maria van der Hoeven et M. Jean Lemierre n’ont pas sollicité le renouvellement de leur mandat. Le Conseil d’administration remercie chaleureusement pour sa contribution exceptionnelle Mme Maria van der Hoeven qui a fait bénéficier le Conseil pendant près de 10 ans de sa connaissance de l’économie mondiale de l’énergie, des défis de la transition énergétique et des enjeux géopolitiques associés. En sa qualité de Présidente du Comité d’audit depuis 2021, Maria van der Hoeven a notamment supervisé les travaux de ce comité sur la prise en compte des évolutions réglementaires en matière de reporting extra-financier. Le Conseil d’administration tient également à remercier tout particulièrement M. Jean Lemierre qui a fait bénéficier le Conseil tout au long de son mandat de sa longue expérience du monde financier, tant en France qu’à l’international ainsi que de la gouvernance de grandes entreprises françaises. Ses avis ont été précieux pour les travaux du Conseil et de ses comités, notamment le Comité de gouvernance et d’éthique et le Comité Stratégie & RSE. Le Conseil d’administration a décidé de proposer à l’Assemblée générale la nomination de deux nouveaux administrateurs indépendants, Mme Helen Lee Bouygues et M. Laurent Mignon, pour une durée de trois ans, en remplacement de Mme Maria van der Hoeven et de M. Jean Lemierre. D’origine coréenne et de nationalités américaine et française, Mme Helen Lee Bouygues réside en France depuis 2004. Elle est titulaire d’un MBA de Harvard Business School . Depuis plus de 25 ans, elle accompagne la transformation stratégique de sociétés françaises et internationales de premier plan. Grâce à ses nombreuses expériences en tant qu'administrateur et membre de comités d'audit de sociétés cotées, telles que les sociétés Neoen SA et Viridien SA (ex-CGG), Helen Lee Bouygues a développé une connaissance vaste des différents enjeux auxquels sont confrontées les entreprises, notamment dans le domaine de l'énergie. Mme Helen Lee Bouygues fera ainsi bénéficier le Conseil de ses compétences financières et stratégiques. Laurent Mignon, de nationalité française, diplômé d'HEC et de l' Executive Program de Stanford, est président du Directoire de Wendel, société d’investissement, et Président du Conseil d’administration de Bureau Veritas, société que Wendel contrôle et consolide par intégration globale. Il fera bénéficier le Conseil de son expertise de premier plan dans le secteur bancaire et financier et de la richesse de son parcours en matière d'investissements et de direction générale d'entreprises cotées. Tout au long de sa carrière, il a conduit avec succès la transformation et le développement des entreprises qu'il a dirigées, avec une volonté permanente de création de valeur durable. La nomination d’un nouvel administrateur représentant les salariés actionnaires, en remplacement de Mme Emma de Jonge, sera également soumise au vote de l’Assemblée générale. Le Conseil recommandera à l’Assemblée Générale la candidature de Mme Valérie Della Puppa-Tibi, présentée par le fonds d’actionnariat salarié FCPE TotalEnergies Actionnariat France (TAF), le plus important en terme de part du capital détenue par les salariés (4,82% du capital de la Société au 31 décembre 2024). Mme Valérie Della Puppa-Tibi, qui a déjà siégé au Conseil d’administration de 2019 à 2022, sera immédiatement en capacité de contribuer pleinement aux travaux du Conseil. Le Conseil d’administration remercie Mme Emma de Jonge pour sa contribution active aux travaux du Conseil. À l’issue de l’Assemblée générale du 23 mai 2025, si les résolutions proposées et agrées sont approuvées, le Conseil d’administration sera composé de 14 membres dont 8 français et 6 internationaux. La proportion d’administrateurs indépendants au sens du Code Afep-Medef sera de 82%, ce qui est au niveau des meilleurs standards, et les proportions de femmes et d’hommes seront respectivement de 45% et 55%. Rapport Sustainability & Climate – 2025 Progress Report A l’occasion des Assemblées Générales de 2023 et 2024, en réponse à des projets de résolutions consultatives déposés à l’initiative d’actionnaires, le Conseil d’administration a réaffirmé son attachement fort au dialogue actionnarial et invité les actionnaires qui souhaitent ouvrir un débat avec le Conseil d’administration à déposer un point à l’ordre du jour de l’Assemblée Générale des Actionnaires comme le prévoit le Code de commerce en soulignant notamment que « ce serait à l’avenir une meilleure voie pour engager le dialogue avec les actionnaires ». Dans un contexte d’évolutions réglementaires majeures (CSRD) et de controverses vis à vis de la pratique du Say on Climate via des résolutions consultatives, le Conseil d’administration a fait réaliser un état des lieux des pratiques de ses pairs, des évolutions de place ainsi qu’une consultation des actionnaires et agences de conseil en votes pour recueillir leurs attentes en matière de Say on Climate . Au terme de cet examen, le Conseil d’administration a décidé d’inscrire à l’ordre du jour de l’Assemblée Générale du 23 mai 2025 un point formel pour débat (sans résolution soumise au vote des actionnaires) portant sur le rapport Sustainability & Climate – 2025 Progress Report rendant compte des progrès réalisés dans la mise en œuvre de l’ambition de la Société en matière de développement durable et de transition énergétique vers la neutralité carbone et de ses objectifs en la matière à horizon 2030. Le Conseil d’administration a l’intention de pérenniser cette pratique d’un point à l’ordre du jour lors des prochaines assemblées générales. En cas de changement significatif de la stratégie de l’entreprise, le Conseil d’administration prendrait l’initiative de soumettre la stratégie Sustainability & Climate à un vote consultatif des actionnaires. Le Conseil d’administration rappelle qu’il est fondé à ne pas accepter l’inscription à l’ordre du jour de résolutions consultatives actionnariales qui empièteraient sur les compétences propres du Conseil dans le cadre de la législation française, notamment en matière de gouvernance ou de stratégie, ainsi que le Président du tribunal de commerce de Nanterre l’a confirmé à l’occasion de l’Assemblée Générale 2024 de la Société, mais invite les actionnaires qui le souhaiteraient à proposer des points pour débat à l’ordre du jour de l’Assemblée Générale ou à interroger le Conseil par des questions écrites. Le rapport Sustainability & Climate – 2025 Progress Report fera l’objet d’une présentation en ligne le 27 mars 2025. La présentation sera suivie d’une session de questions-réponses. L’évènement sera retransmis en direct sur le site totalenergies.com à partir de 14h00 (heure de Paris). La présentation ainsi que le rapport seront accessibles sur le site. Autres résolutions Le Conseil d’administration soumettra également à l’Assemblée générale l’approbation des résolutions relatives à la rémunération de ses mandataires sociaux ainsi que plusieurs résolutions d’ordre financier. ***

title: Smobi’s Top 5 Tips to Boost Cart Checkouts and Get More Sales with RCS Instant Messaging
summary: Learn how your eCommerce business can adapt to consumer demands with a streamlined checkout process.
body_text: Let's face it, a stressful and long-winded checkout process is a serious sales killer. Every extra click, every unnecessary form, every unexpected cost is a potential roadblock between your product reaching the hands of a happy customer. More than ever, online shoppers demand a simple, fast, and efficient checkout experience- anything less may steer them in the direction your competitors. Enter the hero of this story- Rich Communication Services (RCS) instant messaging (the next-generation of SMS marketing). RCS offers a dynamic solution to address buyer hesitation during the final stages of a purchase. Why is this so important? Well, having a direct line of communication to a hesitant buyer is a game-changer for closing the deal. It's the difference between a lost sale and a loyal customer. Think about it- doubt creeps in, questions arise, and suddenly, that “add to cart" and "purchase" enthusiasm starts to wane. With RCS, you can intercept that hesitation in real-time. Answer pressing questions, address concerns, and ultimately, guide buyers to completing their purchase. Even with the power of RCS at your fingertips, a poorly designed cart checkout can still sabotage your sales. It's like having a super-fast delivery service but a warehouse full of unmarked delivery packages. No matter how quickly you could offer sales support, the underlying problem prevents success. So, let's talk about the common checkout challenges that lead to abandoned carts, and how to fix them, while leveraging the power of RCS. Step 1: Offer Multiple Payment Options at Checkout Flexibility is paramount when it comes to payments. Customers have diverse preferences, and offering a variety of options caters to everyone. Support a wide range of payment methods, including: Credit and debit cards Popular digital wallets like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services And even, direct bank transfers Providing this level of choice empowers customers and removes potential issues that prevent the completion of a purchase. Step 2: Enable One-Click Checkout to Boost Your Sales One-click checkout is a game-changer for conversions. By streamlining the buyer's journey and eliminating the tedious tasks of navigating multiple payment windows, you significantly reduce doubt and encourage boost cart checkouts. Think about aspects like filling in forms, no one enjoys doing this again and again. If repeat customers only need to enter their information once, and your online store securely stores this information for future transactions, they’re more likely to develop loyalty. RCS can further enhance this experience by offering one-tap checkout links with discount codes for returning customers. The less steps involved, the higher your conversion rate will be. Step 3: Use Real-Time Customer Support Hesitations and uncertainties can easily derail a purchase. Addressing these concerns in real-time is crucial. Common challenges that deter a purchase a include: Shipping costs Delivery times Insufficient product information Payment issues RCS tackles this challenge by providing a form of instant communication, allowing customers to chat with your support team directly from the checkout page. This is a speedy and effective way to eliminate doubts and keep buyers engaged in the purchasing process. You can even take this a step further for larger scale order queries and enhance your RCS communication with RCS AI-agents that can handle more generalized queries and frequently asked questions (FAQs), while human agents can step in for more complex inquiries, providing a robust customer support experience. Step 4: Send Personalized Reminders and Limited-Time Offers With RCS Creating a sense of urgency can be highly effective in helping a hesitant customer to make a purchase decision. . If a potential buyer has abandoned their cart you can use RCS messaging to send personalized reminders about items left in their carts, along with exclusive offers, free shipping incentives, or time-sensitive discounts. Remember, a well timed message like, "complete your purchase in the next 30 minutes for 10% off!" can be the nudge a customer needs to finalize their purchase. Step 5: Provide Order Confirmation and Post-Purchase Engagement with RCS Building trust is a non-negotiable for all e-Commerce stores! Sending an RCS message with an instant purchase confirmation reinforces trust in your brand’s ability to deliver and RCS as the messaging medium. Always include detailed order information, such as: Estimated delivery dates Tracking links Order number Returns policy link But, don't stop there! Follow up with personalized product recommendations or loyalty rewards to encourage repeat business and build relationships with your customers. RCS instant messaging offers a powerful edge for eCommerce stores who want to create experiences that target the direct needs of their customers, in real-time, for greater service satisfaction and purchase confidence. Offering multiple payment options, enabling one-click checkout, providing speedy customer support, and sending personalized reminders and offers, is precisely what your online store needs to significantly bolster conversion rates and increase your sales. On that final note, remember that RCS is more than a means to close a deal, it’s the new marketing standard for building long-term loyalty and trust, one smooth checkout at a time.

title: Sono-Tek Corporation Promotes Chris Cichetti to Chief Operating Officer
summary: We are pleased to announce the promotion of Chris Cichetti to the position of Chief Operating Officer (COO). Chris Cichetti joined Sono-Tek in 2005 as an Electrical Engineer and has since held several key roles within the Company, including Senior Application Engineer and Manager of the Application Engineering Department. Most recently, he served as Vice…
body_text: We are pleased to announce the promotion of Chris Cichetti to the position of Chief Operating Officer (COO). Chris Cichetti joined Sono-Tek in 2005 as an Electrical Engineer and has since held several key roles within the Company, including Senior Application Engineer and Manager of the Application Engineering Department. Most recently, he served as Vice President of Sales & Applications Engineering, where he led all of Sono-Tek’s front-end operations, overseeing the sales force, applications engineering team, laboratory facilities, and service team during our highest grossing sales years. With nearly two decades at Sono-Tek, Chris has played a foundational role in the Company’s growth, establishing the Applications Engineering Department and spearheading the development of the Company’s laboratory testing facilities, advanced process development capabilities, and project management initiatives. Today, the Applications Engineering Department has grown into one of Sono-Tek’s largest departments and remains a key driver of the Company’s ability to stay at the forefront of ultrasonic coating technology and its expanding capabilities. Additionally, he has been instrumental in forging and strengthening critical OEM partnerships with both customers and vendors. Chris holds a degree in Computer and Electrical Engineering, with a minor in International Studies, from Worcester Polytechnic Institute. As COO, Chris will expand his leadership responsibilities to include oversight of Sono-Tek’s engineering, manufacturing, and IT operations, in addition to his existing management of sales and marketing, service, and applications engineering. His promotion aligns with Sono-Tek’s strategic focus on enhancing operational efficiencies and driving innovation across the organization. Steve Harshbarger, CEO and President of Sono-Tek, expressed his confidence in Chris’s leadership, stating, “Chris has played a vital role in Sono-Tek’s growth and innovation for many years. His technical expertise, strategic thinking, and ability to build strong relationships make him a great fit for the role of COO. I have no doubt that in this expanded position, he will strengthen our operations and help drive our long-term success. I’m looking forward to seeing the impact he will make in this new role.”

title: Projeto de Fundação: resultado do trabalho em equipe
summary: O projeto de fundação é o resultado da colaboração entre arquitetura e engenharia. Juntas elas criam uma base firme e segura para a construção de uma estrutura.
body_text: O projeto de fundação é uma etapa importante na construção de qualquer edificação, já que ele é responsável por garantir a estabilidade e a segurança da estrutura, seja ela uma casa, um prédio, uma ponte, etc. Para isso, é fundamental que haja uma colaboração efetiva entre os arquitetos e engenheiros envolvidos no projeto. Ambos profissionais devem manter uma constante comunicação e troca de informações ao longo de todo o processo projetual. Além da etapa de fundação, é importante que sejam considerados outros tipos de projetos, como o projeto elétrico , projeto hidráulico e projeto de impermeabilização . Em suma, a parceria entre arquitetos e engenheiros é o que garante que seja atendido todas as necessidades e características do projeto, além de assegurar a qualidade na etapa de execução da edificação. Não deixe de se aprofundar nesse tema tão importante e entender como funciona o processo de projeto de uma obra. Convidamos você a continuar lendo sobre projeto de fundação através dos seguintes tópicos: O que é um Projeto de fundação? Qual a importância de um Projeto de fundação? Como fazer um Projeto de fundação? Quem faz um Projeto de fundação? Aproveite a leitura! O que é um Projeto de fundação? Um projeto de fundação é um conjunto de informações, cálculos e desenhos que detalham o tipo e o dimensionamento das fundações necessárias para suportar uma estrutura de construção. As fundações são a base da estrutura e possuem o objetivo de distribuir as cargas da edificação, incluindo o peso da estrutura, o peso das pessoas e objetos que estarão dentro dela, para o solo de forma segura e estável. O projeto pode incluir detalhes sobre o tamanho e o tipo de estacas, sapatas, blocos de fundação, muros de arrimo e outras estruturas necessárias para suportar a construção. Vamos explicar, ao longo do texto, um pouco sobre cada tipo de fundação. Continue conosco! O projeto de fundação é uma parte crítica do processo de construção. A ausência dessa etapa pode causar uma série de problemas graves, como rachaduras na estrutura, deslocamentos e colapsos. Por isso, é essencial que o projeto seja executado com precisão e de acordo com as normas e regulamentos locais. Qual a importância de um Projeto de fundação? Distribuição de cargas e adequação ao solo A distribuição de cargas é um conceito primordial em projetos de fundação, pois se refere à maneira como as cargas da estrutura são transferidas para o solo. Com isso, uma das funções do projeto de fundação é garantir que as cargas sejam distribuídas adequadamente , de modo a evitar sobrecargas em determinados pontos e garantir a estabilidade da estrutura. Para que isso aconteça de forma adequada, os profissionais devem levar em consideração uma série de fatores, como o tipo de solo , a geometria da estrutura, a intensidade das cargas, entre outros. Através dessas informações, é possível determinar o tipo de fundação mais adequado, bem como as dimensões e profundidades necessárias. Cada tipo de solo possui características próprias, como resistência, compressibilidade, permeabilidade, entre outras, que devem ser levadas em consideração no momento de projetar a fundação. Por exemplo, em solos mais resistentes, pode ser suficiente utilizar fundações superficiais ou rasas, como as sapatas, radiers e as vigas baldrame. Já em solos mais fracos, pode ser necessário utilizar fundações profundas, como as estacas e os tubulões. Outro fator que deve ser levado em consideração é a compressibilidade do solo . Solos com alta compressibilidade podem sofrer afundamento quando submetidos a cargas elevadas, o que pode comprometer a estrutura. Por isso, é necessário que as fundações sejam dimensionadas para distribuir as cargas de forma adequada. A permeabilidade do solo também é um fator importante. Em solos com baixa permeabilidade, pode haver acúmulo de água, o que pode comprometer a resistência do solo e afetar a estabilidade da fundação. Nesses casos, é necessário adotar medidas de drenagem, como a instalação de drenos e galerias. Segurança O projeto de fundação vai além do que construir uma edificação, já que muitos profissionais conseguem realizar tal ato, independentemente da sua formação e especialização. Esse tipo de projeto, realizado por profissional da engenharia civil, tem como objetivo aliar a melhor solução, a economia, segurança e funcionalidade. Ou seja, o projeto de fundação evita o risco de perda do investimento e inclusive de vidas. O projeto de fundação tem uma relação direta com a segurança das construções, especialmente quando se trata de evitar deslizamentos - movimentos de solo ou rocha que se deslocam sobre uma superfície inclinada, sendo capaz de causar grandes danos e colocar em risco a vida dos usuários que habitam ou transitam as áreas afetadas. Nesses casos, é preciso tomar medidas de contenção do solo, como a construção de muros de arrimo e a instalação de sistemas de drenagem pluvial, evitando o acúmulo de água e a consequente instabilidade do solo. Redução de custos Ao contratar o seu serviço para elaboração de um projeto de fundação , o proprietário estará evitando o surgimento de patologias construtivas e, consequentemente, economizando a longo prazo e prolongando a vida útil da construção. Sem um projeto estrutural a obra pode apresentar problemas, demandando gastos adicionais com reparos e reforços, além de atrasos na obra. Com o projeto em mãos é possível saber exatamente quanto de material será necessário para a execução ou quanta terra deverá ser movimentada. O planejamento da escolha dos materiais e tecnologias, permite uma redução no uso de recursos e energia . Atendimento às normas e regulamentos É imprescindível que o projeto de fundação seja elaborado seguindo as normas e regulamentos vigentes, garantindo a segurança, estabilidade e conformidade da obra, além de evitar possíveis sanções e prejuízos financeiros. Por exemplo, a NBR 6122/2010 (Projeto e execução de fundações) define grandezas que devem ser consideradas para a elaboração de projeto dessas estruturas. Para fundações superficiais deve-se considerar a determinação da tensão admissível ou a determinação da tensão resistente. Já para as fundações profundas, como as estacas, deve-se considerar a carga admissível se o projeto for realizado em valores característicos e para os tubulões deve-se considerar a tensão admissível ou tensão resistente de projeto. As cargas ou tensões devem obedecer aos estado limite último (ELU) e estado limite de serviço (ELS). Dentre outras normas relacionadas ao desenvolvimento de projeto de fundação , estão: ABNT NBR 8036/1983 : Programação de sondagens de simples reconhecimento dos solos para fundações de edifícios; ABNT NBR 6484/2020 : Sondagens de simples reconhecimento de solo - Método de ensaio; ABNT NBR 6502/1995 : Rochas e solos - Terminologia; ABNT NBR 6489/1995: Solo - Prova de carga estática em fundação direta; ABNT NBR 7182:2016: Solo - Ensaio de compactação. Outro fator importante relacionado às normas é a obrigatoriedade de apresentação do projeto de fundação para a obtenção de licenças e autorizações para construção. Os órgãos municipais e estaduais podem exigir a apresentação desse tipo de projeto como parte do projeto arquitetônico e estrutural. Como fazer um Projeto de fundação? Análise do solo O engenheiro faz uma análise do solo para determinar suas características, como a capacidade de suporte, a presença de água subterrânea e a possibilidade de liquefação. Isso ajudará nas próximas etapas - determinação das cargas e o tipo de fundação necessária. Relatório de Sondagem SPT | Fonte: Carluc engenharia ‍ A sondagem SPT é um ensaio de penetração padrão utilizado para investigar as características do solo. O método consiste na cravação de um amostrador padronizado em um determinado trecho do solo, em um determinado intervalo de tempo, por meio de um equipamento especializado. A cada metro fincado, é registrada a quantidade de golpes necessários para cravar o amostrador, chamado de "número de golpes SPT". É coletado então amostras de metro a metro. Os resultados obtidos identificam as camadas, a espessura, profundidade e características geotécnicas. Determinação das cargas Nessa etapa do projeto de fundação é determinado, pelo profissional responsável, as cargas que a estrutura irá suportar, isto é, a força que age sobre a estrutura, incluindo o peso da construção e as cargas dinâmicas, isto é, os ventos, a movimentação de pessoas e dos equipamentos, entre outras. Essa carga é determinada por meio de cálculos que consideram alguns pontos, por exemplo, o uso da edificação, o número de pavimentos, sua dimensão e o peso dos elementos. Nessa etapa, é essencial que as sondagens do solo já tenham sido analisadas e resultadas em informações precisas. Tipo de fundação O tipo de fundação irá depender das características do solo e da magnitude das cargas a serem suportadas. Existem algumas categorias e subcategorias de fundação, que citamos anteriormente, entre elas estão: Fundação rasa ou superficial: é a mais simples e econômica, sendo indicada para solos firmes e resistentes. É composta por uma base que distribui a carga da estrutura em uma área maior do solo, evitando o afundamento. Alguns exemplos são a sapata isolada, a sapata corrida e o radier. Fundação profunda: é utilizada quando o solo é fraco ou instável, ou quando as cargas são muito elevadas. São executadas em profundidades maiores, podendo ser do tipo estaca, tubulão ou caixão. Sapata isolada Sapata isolada | Fonte: Carluc engenharia É um tipo de fundação rasa que se compreende em uma base em formato de placa, localizada sob um único pilar. Feitas de concreto armado, suas tensões de compressão são resistidas pelo concreto e a tração pelas armaduras. Sapata corrida Sapata corrida | Créditos: Shutterstock É uma base, também do tipo raso, em formato de viga que se estende por toda a extensão da parede ou muro que será apoiado. Ou seja, é mais utilizada para edificações onde a própria alvenaria faz a função de pilar. Radier Fundação em radier após a concretagem | Fonte: Escola da Engenharia Consiste em ser uma laje de concreto armado que se estende por toda a área da construção, distribuindo uniformemente a carga do edifício sobre o solo. Estaca Estaca escavada | Créditos: Shutterstock A estaca é um tipo de fundação profunda em formato vertical ou inclinado, sendo esse elemento cravado no solo através da escavação. Assim, é possível transmitir a carga da edificação para camadas resistentes do solo. Tubulão Fonte: WFF Fundações Pertencente também ao grupo de fundação profunda, o tubulão é um elemento cilíndrico escavado sobre o solo através de ferramentas rotativas. Caixão É uma estrutura de concreto armado, em formato de caixa, cravada no solo por percussão ou escavação. Dimensões e profundidade O engenheiro estrutural faz cálculos para determinar as dimensões e profundidade das fundações necessárias, levando em conta o tipo de fundação escolhido e as cargas que a estrutura irá suportar. Documentação Após os passos anteriores, é chegada a hora de documentar as informações pertinentes para que o construtor possa executar tudo da melhor maneira possível. Para isso são desenvolvidos as pranchas com os detalhamentos de lajes, vigas, pilares e plantas de formas. A empresa de engenharia Carluc afirma que os elementos do projeto de fundação tem como finalidade não deixar dúvidas e nem necessidade de dedução no canteiro de obras. A planta de forma representa os moldes que serão utilizados na concretagem. Elementos na Planta de Fôrmas | Fonte: Carluc engenharia Uma observação importante é que deve-se ter cuidado com a representação dos níveis para que não ocorram erros na hora da execução. Fonte: Carluc engenharia Outro passo importante nessa fase é o detalhamento dos elementos da fundação, esse processo consiste em ser a representação gráfica e textual das dimensões dos elementos, bem como de suas ferragens. É importante verificar se todas as normas e regulamentos técnicos estão sendo cumpridos, garantindo a segurança e qualidade da obra. Já no memorial descritivo , são elencados os métodos construtivos, os materiais, equipamentos e demais informações para que a execução da fundação seja feita de forma eficaz. Por fim, o projeto de fundação é submetido à aprovação de autoridades competentes antes do início da construção. Quem faz um Projeto de fundação? Sabe-se que os arquitetos são responsáveis por estabelecer as características e as necessidades do projeto arquitetônico, como a estética, a funcionalidade, a circulação e a iluminação, entre outros aspectos. Já os engenheiros estruturais são responsáveis por desenvolver os cálculos necessários para determinar o tipo, tamanho e profundidade dessas estruturas, além de elaborar os desenhos detalhados das fundações e de outros elementos estruturais. O projeto de fundação é geralmente preparado por um engenheiro estrutural, que considera fatores como o tipo de solo, as condições climáticas locais, as normas e regulamentos de construção aplicáveis e o tipo de construção a ser erguida. Mas para que se garanta um projeto de fundação segura e eficiente, é necessário a colaboração entre arquitetos e engenheiros desde o início do projeto. Primeiro, ambos os profissionais precisam ter conhecimento e respeitos pelas competências um do outro e tenham uma reunião inicial para discutirem as necessidades da estrutura. O engenheiro, então, realiza a análise do solo e toma a decisão da fundação mais adequada para o caso. Posteriormente, o arquiteto define a planta de fundação, considerando o posicionamento dos pilares e a distribuição de cargas orientadas pelo profissional da engenharia. Assim, o engenheiro analisa essa planta e faz os ajustes necessários, caso houver, garantindo as dimensões e profundidades suficientes para suportar as cargas das estruturas. #Lembre-se: O processo de colaboração pode variar dependendo do tipo de projeto e da equipe envolvida. ‍ Até a próxima, Equipe Vobi ‍ Referências: https://www.geoscan.com.br/ https://carluc.com.br/ https://www.stant.com.br/ https://educacivil.com/ https://www.escolaengenharia.com.br/ ‍ ‍

title: Bauma 2025: What to Expect at Enerpac’s Biggest Ever Stand
summary: Get a preview of the Enerpac Stand At Bauma 2025. Enerpac is making its biggest impact yet, with a record-breaking 500m²
body_text: Bauma 2025, the world’s leading construction machinery trade fair, is nearly here! From April 14 – 20, Munich will host this premier event for construction management, heavy lifting, manufacturing, and material processing industries. This time, Enerpac is making its biggest impact yet, with a record-breaking 500m² stand featuring 11 live demonstrations. If you’re attending to research equipment investments or expand your specialist know-how, make sure to visit the Enerpac stand FS1111/5 for an exclusive look at industry-leading lifting, material handling, and industrial tooling solutions. Why Visit the Enerpac Stand at Bauma 2025? Enerpac’s presence at Bauma 2025 is all about demonstrating how hydraulic solutions can streamline operations, improve safety, and boost productivity. Whether you’re looking for heavy lifting solutions, material handling innovations, or precision bolting tools, you’ll find something valuable. Key Product Highlights at Bauma 2025 Here’s a sneak peek at some of the must-see exhibits at the Enerpac stand organised by project type NEW Smart Transporter Solutions & In-Factory Material Handling For efficient in-factory material handling and industrial moving, explore a range of solutions designed to improve workflow and load management. DTA Automated In-Factory Moving Solutions: Witness the future of material handling with ‘DTA by Enerpac’ Self-Propelled Electric Transporter, one of the many load moving transporters available from the recently Enerpac-acquired DTA Systems. Learn about the AGV (Automatic Guided Vehicles) and ARM (Automated Mobile Robotic) technologies that transport loads up to 1,000 tons with millimetre precision. This is a major highlight on the Enerpac stand, demonstrating the innovation and flexibility Enerpac brings to lifting and moving loads on-site. ML40 Mini Gantry: See the 40-ton entry-level gantry system in action, including how it teams up with the DTA Transporter – perfect for industrial movers seeking a compact, versatile and powerful lifting solution. SBL600 Gantry: Explore the capabilities of the Super Boom Lift hydraulic gantry, offering a stable lifting platform for handling large loads up to 612 tons during factory moves and on-site equipment installations. At Bauma Enerpac will also be previewing the latest updated Wireless Gantry Controller. You can also preview Enerpac’s updated C5 gantry wireless controller that keeps the operator at a safe distance from the lifting operation. ETR Electric Trolley & EMLS Electric Load Skates: Discover how these solutions can simplify the movement of heavy equipment and materials within your facility. ETT Turntable: See how the ETT-Series Turntable, capable of handling loads up to 400T, can rotate heavy loads in tight spaces Solutions For Infrastructure, Bridge Installation & Maintenance at Bauma 2025 If your work involves infrastructure or bridge projects, here are some of the key technologies on display at Bauma: JS250 Jack-Up System: Learn how this system can lift bridge decks and other heavy infrastructure components with precision and control. Strand Jacks : Explore the power and versatility of strand jacks for infrastructure, offshore energy, tunnelling, and mining projects. EVO Synchronous Lifting Systems and Hydraulic Cylinders : Learn how Enerpac EVO cylinders can be used for precise positioning and movement of heavy loads in bridge construction and maintenance. Low-Height Skidding System: See how heavy loads can be moved horizontally in areas with low headroom clearance. SCJ-Series Cube Jacks: See this compact jack-up system in action, ideal as a safer alternative to climbing jacks and cribbing systems. Heavy Equipment Maintenance For those involved in heavy equipment maintenance, these systems offer solutions for safer and more efficient lifting and servicing. Cube Jacks for Maintenance: See how the Enerpac SCJ-Series Cube Jacks, offers a safer, CE-certified approach to lifting and holding an entire cab, boom and arm, allowing the undercarriage to be safely removed. Pin Pullers: Learn about the efficient and safe removal of joint pins from construction machinery using Enerpac’s PPH-Series Hydraulic Pin Pullers. BTW Battery Torque Wrench: Experience the precision and speed of this battery-powered torque wrench, designed for cordless convenience and precision bolting. Pow’R-Riser Wheeled Jack and the LGH-Series 100-ton Hydraulic Puller : Explore these tools for lifting loads in-situ, and for pulling heavy shaft-mounted heavy components. Beyond Heavy Lifting at Bauma 2025- Tools for Every Job Precision and efficiency matters for smaller tasks too! Enerpac’s versatile hydraulic tools enhance productivity and reliability, ensuring you have the right equipment for every job. • Hydraulic Cylinders: A broad selection for lifting, pushing, pulling, and positioning. • Hydraulic Pullers: For removing stubborn parts and components. • Hydraulic Cutters: Powerful cutting solutions for various materials. • Hydraulic Pumps: A choice of reliable power sources for hydraulic tools. • Hydraulic Torque Wrenches: Ensuring accurate and consistent torque application. • Toolbox Sets : Convenient kits containing pumps and cylinders for on-the-go repairs. Don’t Miss Enerpac at Bauma 2025! With our biggest-ever stand and 11 live demos, Enerpac is bringing next-level innovation to Bauma 2025. Visit us at FS.1111/5 to experience cutting-edge hydraulic technology and speak with our experts. Book an Appointment Can’t attend? Watch out for our update after the show, in the meantime, if you have any questions reach out to our Heavy Lifting Specialists! Contact a Heavy Lifting Specialist

title: Top Applications for Online Learning in India
summary: Explore the best online class apps in India with top picks like Byju’s and Unacademy. Choose the right app with our features guide. Sign up now!
body_text: Product Insights Top Applications for Online Learning in India 11 March 2025 9 min read Facebook Twitter Reddit Pinterest Email Introduction The online learning revolution in India has exploded, turning the once-distant dream of global classrooms into an everyday reality. Picture this: whether you’re a passionate teacher, a seasoned professor, or a lively Zumba instructor, the digital era has handed you a golden ticket to connect with eager learners from every corner of the world—all without leaving the comfort of your home. Exciting, isn’t it? Your humble living room can now transform into a vibrant hub of learning, bursting with energy and possibilities. Ready to plunge into this thrilling world of online teaching? Let’s take a closer look at the game-changing apps shaping India’s education scene, the unique features they bring to the table, and how they can supercharge your teaching journey. But first, let’s pause for a moment to appreciate how the digital age has completely rewritten the rules of traditional learning—because what’s unfolding is nothing short of magical. Evolution of Online Learning in India India has always valued education as a cornerstone of personal and societal growth. With a population eager to learn and adapt, educational apps emerged as a response to the growing demand for accessible, affordable, and quality education. Initially, these platforms catered to urban students preparing for competitive exams, but today they have expanded to serve learners of all ages and disciplines. From humble beginnings to becoming household staples, education apps have evolved to meet the dynamic needs of Indian learners. And just when digital learning was finding its footing, a global event– COVID-19 catapulted its growth overnight. In 2023, online education apps generated a whopping $5.93 billion in revenue, much of it fueled by the pandemic’s urgency. For educators, this period marked a turning point. They could connect with students nationwide, breaking geographical barriers and expanding their reach. What began as a necessity was now a thriving ecosystem of virtual classrooms, catering to millions every day. Popular Tools for Teachers and Classroom Management When it comes to managing classrooms and ensuring a smooth learning experience, teachers need tools that help them stay organized, communicate effectively, and engage students. In this section, we’ll explore some of the most popular tools that are designed to help teachers enhance their classroom management and create a positive, efficient learning environment. 1. Exly Exly can greatly help you in managing your online and offline classes more effectively and efficiently. With the proper use of this platform, you can see growth in your coaching business in a short period of time. Key Features: Effortless Class Management: Keep track of your in-person and online classes all in one place with our intuitive dashboard. Simple Scheduling: Easily schedule your classes – whether it’s weekly, monthly, or one-on-one sessions. Quick Class Start-Up: Go live with your online classes in just four easy steps. Calendar Sync: Stay organized by seamlessly syncing your class schedule with your preferred calendar. Smooth Payments: Collect payments from students worldwide with ease. Student-Friendly Access: Give your students easy access to their classes on any device. Launch Your Online Class App : Easily create your own app and make it available on iOS and Android, reaching a wider audience and enhancing accessibility for your learners. 2. Google Classroom Google Classroom is a tool by Google that helps teachers and students manage schoolwork online. Teachers can share assignments, collect work, and grade everything in one place. It’s an easy way to keep all schoolwork organized and make classroom tasks digital. 3. OneNote OneNote is a digital notebook from Microsoft for organising notes, ideas, and multimedia. It is useful for both personal and collaborative work. 4. ClassDojo ClassDojo connects teachers, students, and parents to share updates and feedback. It helps in building a positive classroom community. Leading Applications for K-12 Education and Competitive Exams Students in India are increasingly turning to educational apps for K-12 learning and competitive exams, drawn by their interactive features, personalised content, and anytime accessibility. Here’s a look at some of the top applications making waves in the education space for grades K-12 and competitive exams. 1. Meritnation Meritnation is an online learning platform offering study materials, tests, and interactive lessons for school students in India. Grades catered: 6-12 2. BYJU’s A popular app providing video lessons, quizzes, and personalized learning programs for students across different grades and competitive exams. Grades catered: K-12 and beyond 3. Vedantu A platform that offers live online classes and personalized tutoring for school students and exam preparation. It focuses on real-time interaction between teachers and students. Grades catered: K-12 4. Toppr Topper is an app designed to help students with customized learning paths, practice questions, and preparation for school exams and competitive tests. Grades catered: 5-12 5. Khan Academy Khan Academy offers free online resources in the form of video lessons, practice exercises, and a wide range of topics, aimed at making quality education accessible to all. Grades catered : 1-12 Shifting focus from K-12 online classes app to entrance exam coaching tools opens up a world of exciting possibilities. After all, while K-12 apps focus on building foundational knowledge, entrance exam coaching apps take things up a notch, preparing students to tackle the next big academic milestone. Online Learning Applications for Government and Competitive Exam Preparation In 2024, a staggering 24 lakh (2.4 million) students competed for just 110,000 seats in the NEET exam, while over 14 lakh (1.4 million) students appeared for both sessions of JEE Mains. With such tough competition, more students in India are now relying on online learning apps to prepare for competitive and government exams. These apps make studying easier by breaking down complex topics, offering practice tools, and providing personalized guidance. They’re changing how students prepare, helping millions stay focused and ready for success. 1. Unacademy Unacademy is an online platform offering live classes, video lessons, and mock tests for students preparing for school exams and competitive entrance tests. Exams catered: UPSC CSE GS, IIT-JEE, NEET-UG, CAT, Bank Exams, CA Intermediate, UGC NET 2. Testbook Testbook is a digital resource providing e-books, practice tests, and study guides for students to access academic content on various subjects. Exams catered: Covering UPSC, State PSC, Engineering, Banking, UGC NET, Teaching, State, Police, Judiciary, Nursing, Defence Exams 3. GradeUp (Now Byju’s Exam Prep) Gradeup, now known as Byju’s Exam Prep, is a comprehensive online classes app for competitive exam preparation. Exams catered: IAS, GATE, CDS, SBI, MBA, CTET, UGC NET and 300+ more Comprehensive Exams With competitive exam apps setting the stage for academic success, the journey of learning doesn’t end there. In the current scenario, the focus is also shifting towards acquiring practical skills like coding and advanced analytics. Applications for Learning Coding and Advanced Analytics The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 has taken a visionary step by introducing coding classes for students as early as Class 6. This move aims to embed essential coding skills into the foundation of education, preparing young minds for a future shaped by technology and innovation. In a world where coding is the new literacy and data drives decisions, these platforms empower learners to go beyond textbooks—equipping them with the tools to thrive in this tech-driven world. 1. Coursera Coursera is a popular online platform offering courses, certificates, and degrees from universities and companies worldwide across a range of subjects. 2. Udemy Udemy is a marketplace with thousands of video-based courses on various topics, created by instructors from around the globe. 3. Simplilearn Simplilearn is for those who mean business when it comes to learning. With its focus on professional certification programs, it’s the platform where upskilling meets career advancement. 4. Sololearn Sololearn is an app designed for learning coding through interactive lessons, quizzes, and a community-driven environment. 5. Codecademy Codecademy is a platform for learning programming and coding skills through hands-on exercises and real-world projects in languages like Python, JavaScript, and more. Features to Consider When Choosing a Learning App Now that we’ve explored a variety of platforms and online class apps, it’s clear that each has its own unique strengths, catering to different learning needs and goals. With so many eLearning apps out there, picking the right one can feel like finding a needle in a digital haystack. But don’t worry— Here’s a handy list of must-have features to make your decision a whole lot easier. 1. Purpose: Know Why You’re Learning Before choosing a course, think about your purpose for learning the topic. Are you preparing for an exam, upskilling for your career, or learning a new hobby? Choose a course that aligns with your specific goal to ensure you stay motivated and focused. 2. Content Quality and Engagement The app should offer high-quality lessons that are clear and easy to understand. Look for apps that keep you engaged and offer material that aligns with your learning goals, making it easier to absorb new concepts. 3. User Interface and Ease of Navigation You want an app that’s simple to use. A clean, easy-to-navigate design helps you focus on learning instead of wasting time figuring out how to find your lessons or activities. A user-friendly app makes your experience much more enjoyable. 4. Interactive and Gamified Learning Options Learning becomes more interesting when it’s interactive. Apps with features like quizzes, games, or challenges help keep you motivated and make the learning process fun. These features are great for staying engaged and improving your skills. 5. Availability of Offline Learning Resources Not everyone has constant internet access, so offline resources can be a big plus. Choose an app that lets you download lessons or study materials, so you can keep learning even when you don’t have an internet connection. By focusing on these features, you can pick an app that makes learning easier, more fun, and accessible anytime, anywhere. Wrapping up Educational apps are turning learning into a whole new ballgame—easier, smarter, and way more flexible. Whether you’re mastering the art of coding or trying to charm your way through a new language, there’s an app for everything! Looking ahead, the online learning space in India is set to grow even more. Revenue in this sector is expected to increase at a rate of 25.77% CAGR annually from 2025 to 2029, reaching a projected market volume of US$18.94 billion by 2029. Whether you’re a Yoga instructor or a professor, embrace this digital wave and transform the way you teach today! If you’re looking to start or expand your online teaching journey, check out Exly’s online class app. With Exly you can: Customize your availability as per your schedule Take classes one-on-one or in batches Payment gateways to collect fees With an All-in-One dashboard and customizable options, it’s the perfect platform that offers a great teaching and learning experience. Start your journey today! Manage your classes effortlessly with Exly! title: Rock to Road™: Astec Brings Infrastructure Solutions to World of Asphalt/AGG1
summary: Rock to Road™: Astec Brings Infrastructure Solutions to World of Asphalt/AGG1
body_text: Home Resources News Press Releases Rock to Road™: Astec Brings Infrastructure Solutions to World of Asphalt/AGG1 Press Releases | Sustainability Rock to Road™: Astec Brings Infrastructure Solutions to World of Asphalt/AGG1 Astec is set to make a powerful impact when World of Asphalt/AGG1 2025… March 24, 2025 Share: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn., March 24, 2025 – Astec Industries Inc. (NASDAQ: ASTE) is set to make a powerful impact when World of Asphalt/AGG1 2025 opens tomorrow in St. Louis, MO. Visitors to Booth 3307 will discover the latest innovations from Astec in road building, material handling, and infrastructure solutions—all engineered to boost productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. The Rock to Road approach from Astec brings together industry-leading technology, innovative equipment, and unmatched expertise to help customers optimize their operations. Experts will be on-site for one-on-one consultations, offering tailored solutions to meet unique project needs. Featured Equipment and Technologies Astec will showcase a robust lineup of products, including: RP-195 Highway Class Paver featuring SmartEdge™ – A powerful 10′ rubber-track paver engineered for superior ride quality and mat smoothness, featuring FXS™ fume extraction and direct auger visibility. SmartEdge™ Joint Detection Technology – A game-changing laser-based system that ensures precision joint matching and improved longitudinal joints. SB-3000 Shuttle Buggy® MTV Series II – This high-capacity material transfer vehicle enhances safety and efficiency with a tight turning radius, triple pitch auger, and patented ground crew control panel. RX-405 Cold Planer featuring SiteLine™ – A compact, high-performance milling machine with quick-change drum and versatile conveyors. SiteLine™ Camera System – A best-in-class panoramic camera system offering unmatched visibility, improved safety, and boosted productivity. Available on any Roadtec cold-planer. CP-130 Commercial Class Paver – A heavy-duty commercial paver delivering steel-frame durability, dual control stations, and a D track system. EZR3 Highway Class Screed – A lightweight yet durable rear-mount screed that provides enhanced stability, optimized mat quality, and improved ride smoothness. Astec Whisper Jet® LE Burner – A low-energy, low-noise burner delivering high-efficiency performance and reduced emissions. IntelliPac™ Moisture System with RAP Capabilities – A revolutionary system providing real-time data on aggregate moisture levels for cost-saving production adjustments. Intelliflex Burner Controls – An intuitive burner control system enhancing safety, efficiency, and simplified fault diagnostics. Astec Versa Jet™ Burner – A versatile burner system designed for quick setup, retrofit compatibility, and optimized performance. In addition to exploring our latest equipment, attendees can get a glimpse into the future of Astec with exclusive previews, hands-on booth experiences, educational opportunities, and insights into our commitment to sustainability. Exclusive Product Sneak Peek at the all new A50 Jaw Crusher Astec will offer an exclusive first look at the A50 Jaw Crusher, combining the best features from the Pioneer®, Telsmith, Osborn, and Hydra-Jaw® product lines. Set to launch later this year, this next-generation crusher is designed to elevate performance and durability in crushing operations. Augmented Reality Experience Attendees can engage in an interactive augmented reality experience, allowing them to explore asphalt plant layouts, key equipment components, and process flows in a fully immersive digital environment. Sustainability at the Forefront Astec remains committed to sustainable innovation with solutions like the Astec Green System, which enables warm mix asphalt production without additives, reducing energy consumption and emissions while maintaining mix quality. Enhanced Parts Availability and Support Astec is reinforcing its commitment to keeping operations running smoothly with ASTEC Parts, offering a growing inventory and improved fulfillment rates. title: B2B Influencer Marketing: Strategies for Vendors and Influencers
summary: How to build long-term relationships and a win-win-win partner strategy.
body_text: The global value of the influencer marketing industry has more than tripled in size since 2020 . Yet despite its massive popularity, both brands and influencers are still often unclear on how it works. Influencers are unsure how to position themselves, attract the right brands and negotiate terms. Meanwhile, companies are also unsure how to negotiate those terms. They also don’t know how to find influencers who align with their goals or measure the ROI of their B2B influencer marketing strategies. To help provide some clarity for both sides, we’ve enlisted the help of B2B influencer, Jamie Trull . She is a financial literacy coach and a profit strategist who has worked with a number of brands to create ongoing relationships for sponsored content and affiliate programs for her Instagram and YouTube channels. Here’s how she feels both sides can work together for a win-win-win. Why B2B companies need influencer marketing How should you classify B2B influencer marketing? What bucket does it go in? Is it a thought leadership exercise? A lead generation campaign? A search engine optimization (SEO) activity? The right influencer relationship can actually help you with all three! Having a trusted B2B influencer introduce your brand to their audience is one of the best ways to build your thought leadership. This is particularly important for B2B companies looking to get into niche markets. At the same time, an estimated 69 per cent of consumers trust influencer recommendations . This means the right person’s seal of approval could be a real lead gen boost for your brand. And influencer-created content helps your SEO by driving traffic to your site, creating engagement and helping you earn backlinks. That value isn’t limited to traditional search anymore, either. AI tools now pull from exactly the kind of third-party content influencers create — reviews, tutorials, comparisons, first-hand takes — while generating answers to buyer questions. Ask ChatGPT or Perplexity for the best project management tool for a 20-person team and it’s not going to quote your homepage — it’s going to cite the YouTube review, the comparison post or the LinkedIn take from someone it already trusts. A brand that’s never mentioned outside its own website has nothing for those systems to cite. A brand with a network of trusted voices talking about it does. That’s part of why PartnerStack built a Content Marketplace — a way to find and activate the creators already earning that kind of trust, instead of hoping the right ones stumble onto your radar. But it’s important to know that these things are only achieved when there is an authentic fit between the influencer, the brand and the audience. “We really want successful long-term partnerships. Those are what have been the most profitable for our business and for our partners and it's been the best for our audience as well,” said Trull. “We are very audience-focused in terms of not just looking for win-win, but win-win-win.” You might also like: PartnerStack x Evertune turn AI search into influence through new integration . What B2B influencers look for in partnerships One cannot major in influencing in university (yet). As a result, most content creators have to learn as they go. This was certainly the case for Trull. She said that, even though she had a strong background in finance, she still had to learn how to negotiate in this unique space. “I felt really out of my depth in it. I think some of that also comes with, you know, being a woman in finance as well,” said Trull. “You kind of don't know what the market is. You're not really sure what you can charge. You're not really sure what people will pay. And so I think it was a lot of trial and error getting to this point.” Those early days also taught her that authentic long-term partnerships are the best for everyone involved, which is why she found herself turning down opportunities that simply didn’t make sense for her brand. Trull says that a new influencer may receive downright laughable offers. “There are just things that are so far outside of the realm of what we actually do. I have an audience that has a lot of women, so I think people see that and they're like, ‘Oh, anything that relates to women, we're gonna pitch her.’ So we always laugh when we get pitches for feminine hygiene products. I recently got one for adult toys. Not exactly in line with business finance.” Finding the right influencers for B2B campaigns How do you find the right influencer to represent your brand, expand your audience, and hopefully fill your sales funnel? You need to look at their following, but not necessarily the numbers. Cristiano Ronaldo has 678 million Instagram followers, but he’s probably not going to help you promote a B2B SaaS. You need to consider who follows this person. Are these people in your ideal customer profile (ICP) ? Is this creator trusted enough to influence purchase decisions? There are several tools that can help you analyze a would-be influencer’s audience to see if they’re right for your B2B influencer marketing strategies. For example, PartnerStack Marketplace can help you browse over 700 B2B influencers already actively using PartnerStack to market and sell SaaS. See more: B2B influencer marketing for SaaS . Negotiating strategies for B2B influencer marketing How much should you pay an influencer? How much should an influencer charge? Googling or asking an AI chatbot those questions will give you responses ranging between $250 to $10K, which isn’t particularly helpful. Those numbers also don’t include factors such as long-term brand sponsorships, commissions or affiliate relationships, all of which can be advantageous for everyone involved. What happens when you can’t come to an agreement on the price or terms? Trull says that too many brands put all of the onus on the creator to come up with alternate terms when negotiations reach a roadblock. She would much rather work with a brand that comes to the table with their own ideas and alternatives. “I love companies that work with us. I love partners that are open if I come to them and say, ‘Hey, we would love to do a promo. What can we do for our audience?’ And that's really important to us. Because we can talk about this all we want, but we have to give our audience a reason to click our link.” You might also like: B2B Influencer marketing: How to segment and commission creators . On the influencer side of things, new content creators or micro-influencers with smaller audiences may feel like they’re at a disadvantage when it comes to negotiating. They may be asked to justify their rates during a time when they’re still testing the market. In these situations, Trull says it can be invaluable to reach out to other creators. “Something I recommend to other influencers and educators who make money in this way, talk to other people. I think that in the past, everything's been so siloed. And the only people that benefit from that, it's not us. So knowledge is power." She recommends doing your homework as an influencer. “My rates went up when I started talking to other people who were doing this kind of sponsorship work and realizing that they were charging a heck of a lot more. In fact, a few of the men I talked to were charging a lot more with smaller audiences.” She also feels that the best win-win-wins happen when both sides have the same mission. “Mission alignment. For us, that's really important. If you are a strong mission-driven business, tell us about why you’re doing what you're doing.” “It’s important because we are such a mission-driven business. We look for that. Because that shows us this isn't just about profits. This isn't just about shareholders. This is about trying to do something big here, and we know why we’re doing what we’re doing.” ‍ Originally published: May 7, 2025.
